message:
Fixed. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` multiplied the amount by `percent` (0–100) and never divided by 100. A 50% refund therefore came out 50 times too large. It now computes `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`.

`npm test` passes, all 20 tests.
